title: Lemon Treacle Tart with Clotted Cream
summary: Crisp shortcrust filled with a soft, set golden syrup filling sharpened with lemon, served with cold clotted cream.
equipment: 23 cm loose-based tart tin, 3 cm deep

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
lemon, finely grated zest and juice

steps.title: Pastry
steps.text: blitz or rub the flour, icing sugar, salt and butter to fine crumbs. Mix the yolk with the water, add it and work until the dough just clumps; add a few drops more water only if it stays dry. Flatten into a disc, wrap and chill 30 min.

steps.title: Line
steps.text: roll to 4 mm and line the tin, letting the excess hang over the rim. Chill 20 min. Heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan) with the tray inside.

steps.title: Blind bake
steps.text: line with paper and beans and bake on the hot tray 20 min. Lift out the paper and beans and bake 8-10 min more until dry and pale golden. Trim the overhang with a sharp knife. Lower the oven to 150 °C (130 °C fan). A fully baked case stays crisp under the wet filling.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: warm the golden syrup and butter until the butter melts and the syrup is runny but not hot, about 45 °C. Whisk the eggs, cream, lemon zest and juice in the bowl, whisk in the warm syrup, then stir in the breadcrumbs. Rest 5 min so the crumbs swell.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: pour into the warm case and bake 35-40 min until the filling is golden, set at the edge and has only a slight wobble in the middle. A low oven sets the egg gently so the filling stays soft, not rubbery.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: cool in the tin on the rack at least 1 h; it firms as it cools. Serve warm or at room temperature with spoonfuls of clotted cream.

tips: A common mistake is overbaking until the filling is firm; take it out with a slight wobble, as it sets on cooling.
Warm the syrup only until runny; very hot syrup can scramble the eggs.
Make the breadcrumbs from day-old white bread dried in a low oven if you cannot buy them.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep covered at room temperature for 1 day or in the fridge for up to 3 days. Warm slices at 160 °C (140 °C fan) for 10 min.
